scope: Phase 4B bounded checkpoint JSONL crash recovery; remaining credential/session/coexistence requirements are open

rows.requirement: Credential namespace, native persistence, rotation, logout and native failure modes
rows.backend: native OS manager or explicitly owned retained vault
rows.missing_scenario: Additional end-to-end negative service and host credential consumers on all native platforms
rows.result: PARTIAL; selected hosted native keyring and provider credential tests passed on all five PR #26 native jobs; standalone local default run ignored two hosted cases. Additional consumers remain open

rows.requirement: Acknowledged checkpoint after interrupted JSONL append survives restart
rows.backend: owned checkpoint JSONL under JARVIS_CHECKPOINT_ROOT or .jarvis/checkpoints
rows.missing_scenario: Torn unterminated suffix followed by successful append and second restart
rows.platform: Linux locally; native Linux x86_64/arm64, Windows x86_64 and macOS Intel/Apple Silicon CI
rows.result: RED before repair (1 record vs 2); GREEN in all five selected native jobs of run 40665446147, PR #26 13/13 exact-head checks

rows.requirement: Synthetic foreign checkpoint state remains unchanged under owned recovery
rows.backend: distinct temporary Jarvis and synthetic foreign profiles
rows.missing_scenario: Interrupted owned append and subsequent publication with foreign contents invariant
rows.platform: Linux locally; native Linux x86_64/arm64, Windows x86_64 and macOS Intel/Apple Silicon CI
rows.result: GREEN in all five selected native jobs of run 40665446147 for content, entry count and owned restore; ACL/metadata manifests and reparse negatives not covered

rows.requirement: Session and other JSONL consumers recover without loss of acknowledged records
rows.consumer: SessionLineage, CronRegistry and hosted command wrappers
rows.missing_scenario: Full native process replay, corrupt middle records, interrupted writes and cleanup across hosts
rows.result: PARTIAL: PR #26 named checkpoint/TUI tests native green; session/cron write-error and hosted wrapper acceptance open

rows.requirement: Failed session/cron rewrite must not expose unpersisted live state or consume retry IDs
rows.consumer: SessionLineage and CronRegistry public production stores
rows.backend: Owned session and cron JSONL under disposable checkpoint root
rows.missing_scenario: Reconciled-head native verification, separate-process restart, fault after sync, hosted command consumers, multi-process scheduler claims
rows.platform: Original stacked PR #27 head: Linux x86_64/arm64, Windows x86_64, macOS Intel/Apple Silicon; reconciled head pending
